t: Listen to a talk in a history class.
Let's talk about the printing press.
Johannes Gutenberg developed his press with movable metal type around 1440, in the German city of Mainz.
Before that, books in Europe were copied by hand, which made them rare and expensive.
Gutenberg's most famous project, a printed Bible, was finished around 1455.
By the year 1500, printers in more than two hundred European cities had produced an estimated twenty million books.
Cheaper books meant that more people learned to read, and new ideas could travel far faster than before.
